title: Simulated pressure changes in LacI suggest a link between hydration and functional conformational changes.
authors: Kariyawasam, Nilusha L; Ploetz, Elizabeth A; Swint-Kruse, Liskin; Smith, Paul E
one_liner_zh: 该文通过压力扰动模拟研究LacI蛋白构象亚态转换中水合作用的影响，虽非直接TF-DNA结合位点预测，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作构象机制，MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系研究。
abstract: The functions of many proteins are associated with interconversions among conformational substates. However, these substates can be difficult to measure experimentally, and determining contributions from hydration changes can be especially difficult. Here, we assessed the use of pressure perturbations to sample the substates accessible to the Escherichia coli lactose repressor protein (LacI) in various liganded forms. In the presence of DNA, the regulatory domain of LacI adopts an Open conformation that, in the absence of DNA, changes to a Closed conformation. Increasing the simulation pressure prevented the transition from an Open to a Closed conformation, in a similar manner to the binding of DNA and anti-inducer, ONPF. The results suggest the hydration of specific residues play a significant role in determining the population of different LacI substates and that simulating pressure perturbation could be useful for assessing the role of hydration changes that accompany functionally-relevant amino acid substitutions.
abstract_zh: 许多蛋白质的功能与其构象亚态之间的相互转换密切相关。然而，这些亚态在实验上难以直接测量，尤其是确定水合变化对其贡献尤为困难。在此，我们评估了利用压力扰动来采样大肠杆菌乳糖阻遏蛋白（LacI）在不同配体结合形式下可及的亚态。在存在DNA的情况下，LacI的调控域采用开放构象，而在无DNA时，则转变为闭合构象。增加模拟压力阻止了从开放构象向闭合构象的转变，其效果类似于DNA和抗诱导剂ONPF的结合。结果表明，特定残基的水合作用在决定LacI不同亚态群体中扮演重要角色，且模拟压力扰动可能有助于评估与功能相关氨基酸替换伴随的水合变化的作用。
